topography.project_purpose: YieldNest is an onchain capital allocator that aggregates and manages yield-bearing strategies across multiple chains. It offers liquid restaking tokens (e.g., ynETH, ynLSDe) and vault products (e.g., ynETHx, ynBNBx) that optimize returns through EigenLayer and other DeFi protocols.
topography.relationship_narrative: The ynETH family feeds rewards into ynETHx vaults, which issue L2YnERC20Upgradeable tokens. Kernel strategies like ynBTCk and vaults like ynBNBx share the same L2 token standard and are governed by multisigs, with YND serving as the ecosystem token.
